about: Each cmark-gfm example the reader is known to read differently, by category; see BPR-1793. markdown_cmark_spec_tests fails on a difference not listed here and on a listed example that now matches.

categories.footnotes: Footnote targets are numbered and references bracketed, as GitHub draws them (BPR-1543); the spec names targets by label.
categories.github-autolinks: GitHub autolinks bare URLs and addresses (GFM's autolink extension), as the reader does; this core example expects text.
categories.harness-quote-level: Qt's HTML import gives block quote levels to other blocks than the reader (it flattens nesting); the structure is the same.
categories.html-sanitized: HTML is read as GitHub's sanitized subset (BPR-1544); the spec passes raw HTML through.
categories.image-placeholder: Images show an accessible placeholder until images are allowed (RFC-BPR-0084).
categories.link-destination-entities: An entity in a link destination stays undecoded rather than decoded and percent-encoded.
categories.link-percent-encoding: A link destination is kept as written, not percent-encoded; activation encodes it.
categories.list-item-structure: Qt's md4c and its HTML import disagree on a list item that holds a heading, a rule or an empty first line.
categories.md4c-autolinks: Qt's md4c autolinks fewer forms than GFM: a non-ASCII path, mailto: and xmpp: links, an address after a colon or slash, a URL in quotes, an underscore in a host, and it ends a URL differently at trailing parentheses, an entity-like ending or a `<`.
categories.md4c-entities: Qt's md4c knows fewer named entities than the spec, keeps � as U+0000 rather than U+FFFD, and drops an encoded newline.
categories.md4c-setext-backslash: Qt's md4c drops a trailing backslash before a setext underline.
categories.md4c-strikethrough: Qt's md4c ends a single-tilde span with inner spaces differently from GFM.
categories.md4c-tables: Qt's md4c table extension differs from GFM: header and delimiter cell counts, escaped pipes in code, sequential cells, a table straight after a paragraph.
categories.qt-code-in-emphasis: Qt's import does not carry emphasis into a code span inside it.
categories.tab-fallback: A tab partly used as indentation in indented code keeps the source view: an expanded tab cannot be told from authored spaces (BPR-1795).
categories.task-markers: The reader draws native task markers; Qt's HTML import of the expected HTML has none, even rewritten.
